scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Hoo! Hah! Hoo! Hah!
Let me take you away to
a distant spiritual place,
a land of exotic mystery,
my hometown Ayothaya!
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
呼！哈！呼！哈！
讓我帶你去一個遙遠、寧靜而神秘的異域之地，我的家鄉哎喲泰雅！

scripts.text: About Ayothaya.
scripts.translation: 瞭解哎喲泰雅

scripts.text: Go to Ayothaya.
scripts.translation: 前往哎喲泰雅

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
We Ayothayans are a pious people who value peace and sincerity. We endeavor to lead simple, yet noble, lives in harmony with nature.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
我們哎喲泰雅人信仰虔誠，珍視和平與真誠。
我們追求簡樸而高尚的生活，與自然和諧相處。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Our traditional cuisine is world famous. It's no surprise when we serve dishes like Tom Yum Goong, made of Shrimp, Lemon and Chillies, which has a tantalizing aroma and flavor beyond imagining.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
我們的傳統美食舉世聞名，這可不是浪得虛名。
就說泰式BBQ吧，用蝦、檸檬和辣椒做成，香氣和滋味都誘人得難以想像。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
For those who crave adventure, there is an age old story about the Sa-mhing Tiger, an evil creature that haunts our temple ruins.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
喜歡冒險的話，我們這裡還有一個古老傳說。
邪惡的薩姆辛虎，會在寺廟廢墟里出沒。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Hoo! Hahh! Hoo! Hahh!
No man alive can resist the
call of this beautiful land.
Midgardians are
always welcome!
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
呼！哈！呼！哈！
誰能抗拒這片美麗土地的召喚呢？
我們永遠歡迎米德加爾特的朋友！

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Ah, you must pay 10,000 Zeny
if you wish to visit Ayothaya.
If you're ready, we can leave
right now~
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
前往哎喲泰雅需要支付10,000 Zeny。
準備好的話，現在就能出發~

scripts.text: I'm ready, let's go!
scripts.translation: 準備好了，出發

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Hoo! Hah! Hoo! Hah!
Let us be off! Back to my
beautiful Ayothaya!
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
呼！哈！呼！哈！
出發吧，回到我美麗的哎喲泰雅！

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
I am sorry, but you do not have the 10,000 Zeny to travel to Ayothaya. Such a price is nothing compared to the experiences that await you!
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
抱歉，你的Zeny不足，付不起前往哎喲泰雅的10,000 Zeny旅費。
比起在那裡等著你的精彩體驗，這點錢可不算什麼！

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Have you ever dreamed
of a beautiful place filled
with spiritual serenity? You
must have been dreaming
of Ayothaya, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
你可曾夢見一個美麗而寧靜、能讓心靈安歇的地方？
朋友，你夢見的一定是哎喲泰雅。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Hoo! Hah! Hmm! Hah!
So, how did you like Ayothaya? Did you get a chance to try Tom Yum Goong? When you're ready, I shall take you back home.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
呼！哈！嗯！哈！
哎喲泰雅怎麼樣？嘗過泰式BBQ了嗎？
準備好了，我就送你回家。

scripts.text: Go back to Alberta.
scripts.translation: 返回艾爾貝塔

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
You will be welcome to come back whenever you please. I hope that we will see each other again sometime soon. Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
隨時歡迎你回來，希望我們很快再見。
謝謝~

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Ah yes. I understand that it is difficult to take leave of such a beautiful place. Do not worry
and take your time.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
我懂，這麼美的地方，當然捨不得走。
別急，慢慢來。

scripts.text:
[Thang]
There's an ancient,
dreadful building in
Ayothaya that no one
here dares approach...
scripts.translation:
[唐]
哎喲泰雅有座古老陰森的建築，本地人誰也不敢靠近...

scripts.text:
[Thang]
In the past, a few curious people went inside, despite the horror stories, and never returned. What on earth could be going on inside of that place?
scripts.translation:
[唐]
以前，有些好奇的人不信那些恐怖傳聞，進去後卻再也沒出來。
那裡面到底有什麼？

scripts.text:
[Thang]
However, if you want to prove your courage to others, confronting the danger inside might be a worthy challenge for an adventurer...
I think.
scripts.translation:
[唐]
如果你想證明自己的勇氣，進去面對那些危險，也許是個值得冒險者一試的挑戰...
我是這麼想的。

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Hello!
I don't think
we've met before.
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
你好！我們以前沒見過吧？

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
You must be
from Midgard.
After all, I know every single person living in this village.
Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
你一定是米德加爾特來的。
村子裡每個人我都認識，嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Hmm...
May I ask about the land you
come from? I'm curious about
a lot of things in the outside world.
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
嗯...
能跟我說說你的家鄉嗎？
外面的世界，有好多事讓我好奇。

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
You know, like the dresses and jewelry that ladies wear in other countries, whether or not the men are good looking, what kind of songs you have, what kind of girls that guys over there like...
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
比如，別國的姑娘穿什麼衣服、戴什麼首飾，男人長得帥不帥，流行什麼歌，還有男生喜歡什麼樣的女孩...

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Okay~!
Take care and
enjoy your travels!
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
好~！保重，旅途愉快！

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
When you go East from this
village, you will arrive at the ruins of an old shrine. It is now
a nest full of fearsome monsters.
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
從村子往東走，就能到一座古老寺廟的廢墟。
如今那裡成了可怕魔物的巢穴。

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
If you plan to venture through these ruins, you better prepare
as much as you can!
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
想去廢墟冒險的話，一定要做足準備！

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Ah...
I wonder where
my Black Knight is~
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
啊...
我的黑騎士到底在哪裡呢~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't you mean...
Knight in shining armor
riding a white horse?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你想說的難道不是...騎著白馬、身披閃亮鎧甲的騎士嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Hmm...?
Oh, well...
I'll take them both!
Hee hee~!
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
嗯...？哦，好吧...
兩個我都要！嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Mmm...?
What's up?
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
嗯...？
怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Ummm.
Hmmmmm...
Ummmmm...?
scripts.translation:
[村民]
唔。
嗯嗯...
唔唔...？

scripts.text:
[Villager]
You must be
an outsider.
Yes. Yes, indeed.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
你一定是外鄉人。
嗯，沒錯。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Did you just ask
where am I going?
Why, to the Fishing Spot
just ahead. That's what
we old men do: fish.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
你問我要去哪裡？
當然是前面的釣魚點。
我們這些老頭就愛釣魚。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Hmmm...
Would you like to hear
something interesting? I've heard that someone found a ring inside
a fish he caught in the
Fishing Spot.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
嗯...
想聽點有趣的事嗎？
聽說有人在那邊釣了條魚，魚肚子裡竟然藏著一枚戒指。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Supposedly, there are lots of stories about people finding valuables inside of the fish they've been catching there.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
在那兒釣的魚肚子裡找到寶貝，這樣的故事可不少。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
If you're lucky enough,
you might even become
a millionaire.
Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[村民]
運氣好的話，沒準能變成百萬富翁呢。
嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Villager]
...!?
Ah, I came into the fish market! ^666666*Sigh*^000000 It seems I went the wrong way. The Fishing Spot is on the opposite side of this village.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
...！？
哎呀，走到魚市來了！
^666666*嘆氣*^000000
看來走錯路了，釣魚點在村子另一頭。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Since I'm here, it wouldn't be
a bad idea to look around. All of the seafood in this market is fresh and tasty. You'll regret it if you don't try some of this seafood
at least once.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
既然來了，逛逛也好。
這裡的海鮮鮮美得很，不嘗一回，一定會後悔。

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
Phew, isn't it
soooo hot today?
scripts.translation:
[關]
呼，今天也太熱了吧？

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
You must be
from Midgard, huh?
I've seen a lot of tourists
coming from there recently.
scripts.translation:
[關]
你一定是從米德加爾特來的吧？
最近我見過很多從那裡來的遊客。

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
You'd better be really careful if you travel outside of the village. Whatever you do, don't go into
the ruins of an old shrine
in the forest.
scripts.translation:
[關]
出村旅行可得格外小心。
千萬別進森林裡那座古老寺廟的廢墟。

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
That place is far too
dangerous to visit. Still, I hear that if you had some kind of amulet, you could go there with
a little less worry...
scripts.translation:
[關]
那裡太危險了。
不過，聽說帶著某種護身符去，能稍微安心一些...

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
Well, anyway, it's still a really good idea to stay away from that place. I hope you enjoy visiting Ayothaya, and that you keep safe~
scripts.translation:
[關]
總之，還是離那裡遠些為好。
希望你在哎喲泰雅玩得開心，平平安安~

scripts.text:
[Detzi]
In Ayothaya, we have our own traditional martial arts. We, the young men of the village, practice our traditional martial arts in order to become strong.
scripts.translation:
[德齊]
哎喲泰雅有自己的傳統武術，村裡的年輕人都靠練武強身。

scripts.text:
[Detzi]
Why don't you learn our martial arts? I guarantee that it will help you greatly in your travels.
scripts.translation:
[德齊]
要不要學學我們的武術？
保證能在旅途中幫上你不少忙。

scripts.text:
[Eik]
Hey...
You look pretty strong
You wanna challenge
me to a match?
scripts.translation:
[艾克]
嘿...
看起來你挺強的，要不要跟我比一場？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 來吧

scripts.text: Nah~
scripts.translation: 不了~

scripts.text:
[Eik]
Ow ow ow!
I was just
kidding, man!
scripts.translation:
[艾克]
哎喲，哎喲！
我只是開玩笑啊，兄弟！

scripts.text:
[Eik]
I'm not so rude as to pick fights with strangers for no reason!
scripts.translation:
[艾克]
我可沒那麼粗魯，無緣無故找陌生人打架！

scripts.text:
[Eik]
Real power is developed after having thousands of matches with other people. So, don't be afraid of fighting, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾克]
真正的實力，要與人切磋千百回才能磨練出來。
所以別害怕戰鬥，好嗎？
